name: Clear Networks
summary: Melbourne (Blackburn North, VIC) satellite (HiBIS/Optus, later Sky Muster, IPSTAR) + fixed-wireless + NBN fibre ISP (Clear Networks Pty Ltd, sister co. of Day3 via acquisition of Canberra's RBBS); acquired by SkyMesh 2022; infrastructure sold to Summit Internet 2023.

events.details: Clear Networks Pty Ltd founded 2004 in Melbourne (HQ Blackburn North, VIC), sister company of Day3, via acquisition of Canberra's Regional Broadband Services (RBBS); HiBIS-funded Optus satellite broadband and ClearTowns fixed wireless for regional Australia. Earliest Wayback capture 30 Dec 2004.
Acquired by SkyMesh (2022); infrastructure on-sold to Summit Internet (2023).
